channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Bojan Bogdanovic | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Bojan Bogdanovic from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Jordi Fernandez on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Jordi Fernandez on Bojan Bogdanovic's rehab progress:

“He’s progressing well. We’re not gonna give an exact date, but he’s doing good. He’s in good spirits, he had a good week, he was with us on the road. Having him around is very important because he’s a veteran and he’ll talk in huddles, he gives the guys all these tips on what to do during the games. His involvement is very important. To me, that means that he’s working, he cares, and whenever he’s physically ready, he’ll be good for us. I’m very happy to have him around. I’ve known him since when he was a little kid, he played for Real Madrid, then he came to the NBA... I’m very excited to get to coach him.”

Jordi Fernandez on Bojan Bogdanovic, Nov 13, 2024. Source: Twitter @erikslater_.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Omari Sanfoka II:Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic:

“He’s still in our meetings, in our practice, shootarounds, he’s still involved. He gives opinions in our film sessions. If our older players see anything, they speak because they’ve been through it.”

Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic, Apr 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic, Alec Burks
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Dwane Casey on Alec Burks/Bojan Bogdanovic:

“He’s that veteran you want on your team going forward…He and Bogey are the perfect fit for our rebuilding programwhen we’re ready to go forward and take off next year. Those two are just important pieces now and also going forward.”

Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic, Alec Burks, Feb 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on Bojan Bogdanovic, Kelly Oubre
item.description:
“Our bench was deeper than theirs. We had [Bojan Bogdanovic], Kelly Oubre, you know what I mean?”

Tristan Thompson on Bojan Bogdanovic, Kelly Oubre, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Clutch Points.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic:

“He's got a stomach virus that's kicked in. We're going to see how he feels and go from there.”

Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic, Jan 15, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Donovan Mitchell on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Donovan, on Bogdanovic's defense:

“When you got a guy like him making that commitment that early in the game — he didn't tell us he was going to do it, he just did it — you don't want to let him down. That intensity sparked us. … We fed off that.”

Donovan Mitchell on Bojan Bogdanovic, Apr 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Rudy Gobert on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Eric Walden:Rudy Gobert, on Bojan Bogdanovic's defense:

“He set the tone. He set the tone for us. Everyone looks at Bogey and says, 'If Bogey is doing it, why can't I?' It's contagious.”

Rudy Gobert on Bojan Bogdanovic, Apr 23, 2022. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Joe Ingles on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Joe Ingles, on Bojan Bogdanovic finding his shooting form again:

“I'm sure he's been frustrated. … I think he yelled some Croatian swear words today when he hit a 3, which was nice to see. We need him to keep his confidence up, regardless of if he goes 0 for 5.”

Joe Ingles on Bojan Bogdanovic, Apr 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on finding a player in Ersan Ilyasova who brings similar traits to Bogdanovic and Niang:

“Dennis and Justin and our group wouldn't have looked at someone you couldn't plug and play. I think the one thing we've been really conscious of is the chemistry of the team.”

Quin Snyder on Dennis Lindsey, Justin Zanik, Ersan Ilyasova, Bojan Bogdanovic, Georges Niang, Mar 11, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Ben Anderson:Quin Snyder on Bojan Bogdanovic's recent uptick in play (30.5 ppg over the last two games):

“I just try to remember to remind him how good he is, and he's really good.”

Quin Snyder on Bojan Bogdanovic, Feb 2, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on Bojan Bogdanovic:

“We’re gonna try to use him more on the post this year. That’s an area he can be even more effective.”

Quin Snyder on Bojan Bogdanovic, Dec 1, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
Eric Walden:Nate McMillan, on Bojan Bogdanovic:

“We know he doesn’t need a lot of space. He’s hot right now. He’s playing his best basketball this season.”

Nate McMillan on Bojan Bogdanovic, Jan 20, 2020. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson
item.description:
“We’ve got a good story to tell -- with the addition of our $50 million practice facility and the D-League franchise -- and I think we’ll be in a position where we’ll be able to add to Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Bojan Bogdanovic and some of the other younger pieces, and bring in the necessary pieces to turn things around quickly.”

Brett Yormark on Brook Lopez, Thaddeus Young, Bojan Bogdanovic, Rondae Hollis-Jefferson, Dec 19, 2015. Source: NetsDaily.

item.title: Billy King on Bojan Bogdanovic
item.description:
The BrooklynNets will host Fenerbahce Ulker Istanbul of the Turkish Basketball League for a preseason game on October 5, 2015 at 7:30 p.m. at Barclays Center,General Manager Billy King announced today.

“We are excited to be hosting Fenerbahce, as it will be a reunion for Bojan Bogdanovic with his former team,”

Billy King on Bojan Bogdanovic, Jul 28, 2015. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Lionel Hollins on Bojan Bogdanovic, Sergey Karasev
item.description:
Hollins said before the game.

“You’ve got to play and compete and go out and play well. Karasev has shown me a lot in practice. We were struggling, I gave him a shot and he played well. … I put him in the starting lineup and he’s played well. “It’s also a product of [Bogdanovic] just hitting the wall and not being aggressive.”

Lionel Hollins on Bojan Bogdanovic, Sergey Karasev, Jan 3, 2015. Source: New York Post.
